remarks: HIGHESTandBEST Tuesday 5/13, 7PM. South Wilton cul-de-sac, this true 5-bedroom colonial home stands as a testament to meticulous care and the unmistakable pride of ownership. The stately residence, perched atop a gently sloping driveway, welcomes you with its beautifully landscaped gardens, creating an enchanting first impression. As you step inside, the warmth of a well-loved home envelops you. The terrific sunroom, bathed in natural light, offers a tranquil space to enjoy the beauty of the changing seasons. The living room, family room, and dining room are expansive, providing ample space for gatherings, celebrations, and cherished family moments. The heart of this home is the eat-in kitchen, light-filled and inviting. With a touch of modernization, it can easily become the vibrant center of daily life. The finished lower level is a haven of entertainment, featuring a bar and a vast media/playroom, alongside generous storage solutions. This quintessential New England Colonial is not just a house, but a home that has been lovingly preserved and is now ready to welcome new memories. With award-winning Wilton Schools as the backdrop, this home is not only a jewel in its traditional layout but also a wise investment in a lifestyle of convenience and excellence. Priced to sell, this property, an Estate of distinction, awaits the discerning buyer who appreciates quality, location, and a home that has been cherished through the years. Location, a commuter's dream. Estate-AS IS
